description.zh:
目标地址类型：

Ip：Ip

域名：Domain
description.en:
The destination address type. Valid values:

- Ip: IP address.
- Domain: domain name.

description.zh:
执行成功后是否通过MQ推送，默认false：
false：不推送
true： 推送（目前不支持）
description.en:
Specifies whether to push a notification through MQ after successful execution. Default value: false. Valid values:
- false: does not push a notification.
- true: pushes a notification (currently not supported).
The request number. This parameter supports idempotence.

description.zh:
地址类型：

客户配置： user_defined

阿里云预配：aliyun_defined
description.en:
The address type. Valid values:

- user_defined: user-defined configuration.
- aliyun_defined: Alibaba Cloud predefined configuration.

description.zh: 检测到的高危风险域名是否强制添加，默认被拦截，不添加
description.en: Specifies whether to forcibly add a detected high-risk domain name. By default, the domain name is blocked and not added.

title.zh: 定向分组新增目标地址
title.en: Add destination address to targeted group
